headline: Two of Ring’s latest video doorbells are a lot cheaper than usual
summary: Ring's Wired Doorbell Pro and Battery Doorbell Plus are significantly discounted. The Wired Doorbell Pro is $50 off, now $199 at Amazon and Best Buy. The Battery Doorbell Plus is also part of the sale.

headline: Uber CEO brushes off reports of a Waymo break-up
summary: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi denied reports of a Waymo partnership fraying. Despite ending service in Phoenix, both companies are committed to Atlanta and Austin. Khosrowshahi affirmed the partnership remains "very strong."

headline: Apple’s selling refurbished MacBook Neos with a $100 discount
summary: Refurbished MacBook Neos are available from Apple with a $100 discount. All four colors are discounted, bringing them to pre-price hike prices. The base 256GB model is $599, and the 512GB version is $679.

headline: Sure seems like Fenix Flexin used AI music generator Treblo
summary: Fenix Flexin's song "Rubberz" is highly suspected of being created with AI. Musician Medasin specifically pointed to the Treblo AI music generator. A new open-source Treblo AI Music Classifier now seems to confirm its use.

headline: Scalping Has Gotten So Bad That The Pokemon Company Is Limiting Certain TCG Packs to Japanese Citizens Only
summary: Pokemon TCG scalping has become so severe it led to drastic measures. The Pokemon Company is now restricting certain TCG packs to Japanese citizens. Non-Japanese players cannot buy specific decks or expansion packs from the official online store.

headline: T-Mobile Launches New Student Discounts for Wireless Plans That Include Netflix, Apple TV, and Hulu
summary: T-Mobile has introduced three new wireless plans specifically for students. These plans offer significant value, especially for streaming enthusiasts. Included streaming services are Netflix, Apple TV, and Hulu.

headline: Xbox Is Planning Its Own Version of the Platinum Trophy
summary: Xbox is developing its own equivalent to PlayStation's Platinum Trophy. Achievement hunters on the platform can look forward to a new prestigious award. This new feature is expected to launch later this year.

headline: Russo Brothers Congratulate Spider-Man: Brand New Day on Box Office Record
summary: The Russo Brothers, directors of 'Avengers: Endgame,' congratulated 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day.' The new Spider-Man film broke their historic opening weekend box office record. This marks a significant new achievement in cinema history.

headline: Ex neo-Nazi activist withdraws as Tory election candidate
summary: Joshua Bonehill-Paine, a former neo-Nazi activist, has withdrawn as a Conservative election candidate. He will now advise the Conservative party on strategies for tackling extremism. Kemi Badenoch confirmed his new advisory role.

headline: Woman arrested after four stabbed in central London
summary: A woman has been arrested following a stabbing incident in central London. Four men sustained stab wounds in the attack. The Metropolitan Police are currently investigating the circumstances.

headline: University of Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row resigns
summary: Prof Jason Arday has resigned from his position at the University of Cambridge. His resignation comes amidst a significant plagiarism controversy. He stated his departure was the only way to conclude the ongoing chapter.

headline: Family 'devastated' by death of girl, 9, as man charged with murder
summary: The family of 9-year-old Minnie Merriman expressed devastation over her death. A 35-year-old man has been formally charged with her murder. Minnie was found injured in Arbroath earlier this week.
